title: CITE-seq
protocol: Order 5’amine-labelled oligos with a C12 spacer and a specific barcode.
Clean oligo by ethanol precipitation to remove residual synthesis contaminants.
Resuspend all 25 nmoles of lyophilized oligo in 200 µl 0.5M NaCl.
Centrifuge full speed (~18,000g) for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Carefully transfer supernatant to new tube if there is visible pellet.
Add 3 volumes (600 µl) of 100% EtOH.
Incubate at -80°C for at least 30 minutes.
Centrifuge full speed (~18,000g) for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Wash pellet in 80% EtOH.
Centrifuge full speed (~18,000g) for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Wash pellet again in 80% EtOH.
Centrifuge full speed (~18,000g) for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Air dry the oligo pellet.
Resuspend the oligo pellet in 20 µL PBS pH 8.5.
Biotinylate oligo with EZ-link Sulpho-NHS S-S Biotin per manufacturer protocol.
Resuspend Single Use EZ-link NHS S-S Biotin in 164 µl DMSO to make 10mM solution.
Add 10 µl of Biotin-NHS to oligo (100 nmoles, ~4 fold excess over oligo).
Incubate at RT for 5 minutes.
Repeat 4 more additions of 10 µl Biotin-NHS to oligo and incubations for 5 minutes.
Final volume now 70 µl.
Purify oligo by ethanol precipitation.
Increase volume to 400 μl by adding 330 μl water.
Add 40 μl of 5M NaCl.
Add 1.2 mL of 100% Ethanol.
Incubate for at least 30 minutes at -80°C.
Centrifuge at full speed (~18,000g) in a tabletop centrifuge for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Wash pellet in 500 μl of 80% EtOH.
Centrifuge at full speed (~18,000g) in a tabletop centrifuge for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Air dry the pellet shortly.
Resuspend the pellet in water at an estimated concentration of >100 µM (~200 μL).
Add 10 μl of Biotin-NHS to oligo (100 nmoles, ~4 fold excess over oligo).
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Repeat with 4 more additions of 10 μl Biotin-NHS and incubations for 5 minutes each.
Spin oligos at 1000g for 4 minutes at room temperature.
Collect flow through containing biotinylated purified oligo.
Quantify oligo, if needed adjust concentration to 100 µM with TE and store at -20°C.
Verify sufficient biotinylation by running non-labelled control and biotinylated oligo on Agilent Bioanalyzer Small RNA Chip.
Repeat biotinylation if less than 90% of oligo is biotinylated.
Use flow cytometry optimized monoclonal antibody clones.
Verify antibody concentration, ensuring 15 µg of antibody are needed for conjugation.
Pre-wet 50 kDa cutoff column by adding 200 µl PBS pH 8.5.
Combine 15 µg purified antibody with 200 µl PBS pH 8.5 and transfer to column.
Spin at room temperature 4 minutes 14,000g.
Discard flowthrough.
Add 400 µl PBS pH 8.5 to column.
Spin at room temperature 4 minutes at 14,000g until all liquid has drained to 20 µl mark on column.
Recover concentrated purified antibody by placing column upside down in new tube and spin for 2 minutes at 3,000g.
Adjust volume of recovered purified antibody to 30 µl with PBS pH 8.5.
Add 3 μl of modifier solution to 30 μl recovered purified antibody.
Add the modified antibody solution directly onto the lyophilized reactive 10 μg streptavidin.
Mix by flicking the tube carefully.
Incubate for at least 3 hours or overnight at room temperature.
Quench reaction by adding 3 μl quenching solution.
Add 4 μl of 5M NaCl to increase the NaCl concentration to ~0.5M.
Add 4 μl Tween 20 (0.1% in H2O) to get a final concentration of ~0.01% Tween.
Merge streptavidin-antibodies with biotinylated oligos in PBS/0.5M NaCl.
Incubate overnight at room temperature.
Pre-wet 50 kDa cutoff column with ~300 μl PBS.
Transfer oligo-labelled antibodies to the 50 kDa cutoff column.
Spin at room temperature for 4 minutes at 14,000g.
Discard flow through.
Wash antibody-oligo-conjugate 7 times in 0.5M NaCl/PBS on column.
Spin at room temperature for 4 minutes at 14,000g.
Perform the final wash with 1x PBS.
Spin until all liquid has drained to the 20 µl mark on the column.
Place column upside down in a new tube and spin for 2 minutes at 3,000g to recover concentrated purified antibody.
Adjust volume of recovered purified antibody to 30 µl with PBS.
Validate oligo-conjugation by running ~0.7 µg of Antibody on a 4% Agarose E-gel.
Release oligo by treating with 0.2M DTT for 10 minutes at 90˚C and compare to untreated antibody.
Run ~0.7 µg of antibody complex on a 4% Agarose gel (E-gel) for 4 minutes.
Cool the gel before visualization on ice.
Store Antibodies in storage buffer at 4˚C until use (PBS, 1 µg/µl BSA, 0.05% Sodium Azide).
Keep barcoded antibodies as pure stocks.
Pool with other labeled antibodies only directly before use.
Run an aliquot on a 4% agarose gel to verify oligos are still attached if antibodies were not used for more than 3 months.
Prepare antibody panel shortly before CITE-seq run.
Mix 1-2 µg of each antibody-oligo complex in ~300 µl 0.5M NaCl/PBS containing 2 µl of 10 mM biotin.
Incubate the mixture for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Pre-wet a 50kDa cutoff column with ~100 µl 0.5M NaCl/PBS.
Transfer the biotin-blocked antibody panel to the pre-wetted 50kDa cutoff column.
Spin the column at room temperature for 4 minutes at 14,000g.
Discard the flow-through liquid.
Wash the antibody-panel two times in 400 µl 0.5M NaCl/PBS on the column by spinning at room temperature for 4 minutes at 14,000g.
Perform a final wash with 400 µl 1x PBS.
Spin the column until liquid drains to the 20 µl mark on the column.
Recover concentrated purified antibody by placing the column upside down in a new tube and spinning for 2 minutes at 3,000g.
Adjust the volume of the recovered antibody pool to 100 µl with cell staining buffer (2% BSA/0.02% Tween, PBS).
Count cells carefully to ensure accurate quantitation before proceeding with cell labeling.
Note cell viability (>95%) and include dead cells in the total count.
Enrich live cells by FACS if many dead cells are observed.
Resuspend approximately 500,000 cells in 100 µl of staining buffer (2% BSA/0.02% Tween, PBS).
Add 5 µl of Fc blocking reagent (FcX, BioLegend).
Incubate for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Mix 100 µl of antibody-oligo pool containing ~1-2 µg of each antibody or titrated amounts with the cell suspension.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells three times with 1 ml of staining buffer (2% BSA/0.02% Tween, PBS) by spinning 5 minutes at 450g and 4°C.
Resuspend cells in PBS at an appropriate concentration for downstream applications (e.g., 500 cells/µl for 10x or 200 cells/µl for Drop-seq).
Verify cell concentration using a hemocytometer.
Run Drop-seq or 10x Genomics single-cell 3’ assay according to Macosko et al. (Drop-seq) or the manufacturer's instructions until after cDNA amplification.
Perform SPRI selection to separate ADTs (~180bp) and full-length cDNAs (>300bp).
Add 0.6X SPRI to separate ADTs and full-length cDNAs.
Incubate for 5 minutes and place on a magnet.
Retain the supernatant containing ADTs; discard beads containing full-length cDNAs.
Proceed with standard 10x or Drop-seq protocol for cDNA sequencing library preparation.
Purify ADTs using two 2XSPRI purifications per manufacturer protocol.
Add 1.4X SPRI to supernatant to obtain a final SPRI volume of 2XSPRI.
Incubate 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place tube on magnet and wait ~2 minutes until solution is clear.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Add 400 μl 80% Ethanol to the tube without disturbing the pellet and stand for 30 seconds (only one Ethanol wash).
Carefully remove and discard the ethanol wash.
Centrifuge tube briefly and return it to magnet.
Remove and discard any remaining ethanol.
Resuspend in beads in 50 μl water.
Perform another round of 2X SPRI purification by adding 100 μl SPRI reagent directly onto resuspended beads.
Incubate 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place tube on magnet and wait ~2 minutes until solution is clear.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μl 80% Ethanol to the tube without disturbing the pellet and stand for 30 seconds (1st Ethanol wash).
Carefully remove and discard the ethanol wash.
Add 200 μl 80% Ethanol to the tube without disturbing the pellet and stand for 30 seconds (2nd Ethanol wash).
Carefully remove and discard the ethanol wash.
Centrifuge tube briefly and return it to magnet.
Remove and discard any remaining ethanol and allow the beads to air dry for 2 minutes.
Resuspend beads in 45 μl water.
Pipette mix vigorously.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place tube on magnet and transfer clear supernatant to PCR tube.
Amplify ADT sequencing library.
Prepare 100uL PCR reaction with purified ADTs, including:
Mix 45 µl purified ADTs with the mixture.
Add 50 µl 2x KAPA Hifi PCR Master Mix.
Include 2.5 µl Truseq Small RNA RPIx primer at 10uM.
Add 2.5 µl P5 oligo at 10uM, using specific oligos for Dropseq or 10x applications as needed.
Initiate cycling conditions: 95˚C for 3 min; 95˚C for 20 sec | 60˚C for 30 sec with 8-12 cycles; 72˚C for 20 sec per cycle; and finally, 72˚C for 5 min.
Purify PCR product using 1.6X SPRI purification by adding 160 µl SPRI reagent.
Incubate 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place tube on magnet and wait 1 minute until solution is clear.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µl 80% Ethanol to the tube without disturbing the pellet; stand for 30 seconds (first Ethanol wash).
Carefully remove and discard the ethanol wash.
Add another 200 µl 80% Ethanol to the tube without disturbing the pellet; stand for 30 seconds (second Ethanol wash).
Carefully remove and discard the ethanol wash.
Centrifuge tube briefly and return it to magnet.
Remove and discard any remaining ethanol, allowing beads to air dry for 2 minutes.
Resuspend beads in 20 µl water.
Pipette mix vigorously and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place tube on magnet and transfer clear supernatant to PCR tube.
ADT library is now ready to be sequenced.
Quantify library by standard methods (QuBit, BioAnalyzer, qPCR).
Ensure the ADT library is between 170-180 bp.
